challenges.name: fix-driver-shift-ledger
challenges.title: Fix the driver shift ledger that forgets everything
challenges.description: The shift ledger tracks what each Saigon Parcel driver carries, delivers and fails during a shift, and how much cash they collect. Since the ledger was rewritten with methods, nothing sticks: a parcel that was just picked up is "not carried" when the driver delivers it, every counter stays at 0, and the end of the shift changes nothing. Fix the Driver methods and the Fleet so that every change is kept on the driver in the fleet. At the end of the shift every parcel still on a bike counts as failed. The test runner reads driver, pickup, deliver, fail and end commands and prints one line per driver.

tests.name: Pickups, a delivery and a failed delivery are all kept
tests.input:
driver an
pickup an SP-3001
pickup an SP-3002
deliver an SP-3001 250000
fail an SP-3002
tests.expected: an: delivered 1, failed 1, cash 250000 VND, carrying []

tests.name: Two drivers keep separate ledgers; an undelivered parcel stays on the bike
tests.input:
driver an
driver bich
pickup an SP-3001
pickup bich SP-3003
pickup bich SP-3004
deliver bich SP-3004 120000
deliver an SP-3001 90000
tests.expected:
an: delivered 1, failed 0, cash 90000 VND, carrying []
bich: delivered 1, failed 0, cash 120000 VND, carrying [SP-3003]

tests.name: Errors for a parcel that is not on the bike and for an unknown driver
tests.input:
driver chau
pickup chau SP-3010
deliver chau SP-3011 50000
deliver dung SP-3010 50000
deliver chau SP-3010 50000
deliver chau SP-3010 50000
tests.expected:
error: chau is not carrying SP-3011
error: no driver dung
error: chau is not carrying SP-3010
chau: delivered 1, failed 0, cash 50000 VND, carrying []

tests.name: End of shift: every parcel still on a bike counts as failed
tests.input:
driver an
driver ha
pickup an SP-3020
pickup an SP-3021
pickup an SP-3022
pickup ha SP-3023
deliver an SP-3021 300000
end
tests.expected:
an: delivered 1, failed 2, cash 300000 VND, carrying []
ha: delivered 0, failed 1, cash 0 VND, carrying []

tests.name: Removing parcels from the middle keeps the others in pickup order
tests.input:
driver bich
pickup bich SP-3030
pickup bich SP-3031
pickup bich SP-3032
pickup bich SP-3033
fail bich SP-3031
deliver bich SP-3033 45000
tests.expected: bich: delivered 1, failed 1, cash 45000 VND, carrying [SP-3030 SP-3032]

tests.name: After the end of shift the bike is empty and new pickups still work
tests.input:
driver an
pickup an SP-3040
end
pickup an SP-3041
deliver an SP-3041 0
fail an SP-3040
tests.expected:
error: an is not carrying SP-3040
an: delivered 1, failed 1, cash 0 VND, carrying []
